news.title: 7 reasons to stop by the UNI Booth at the Iowa State Fair
news.summary_en: The University of Northern Iowa is heading to the Iowa State Fair, and you won’t want to miss what’s happening at our booth located in the Varied Industries Building. From Aug. 13-23, stop by to shop, connect and show your Panther Pride.

news.title: TC’s Tee returns for fourth year with limited-edition design supporting UNI students
news.summary_en: A University of Northern Iowa tradition is returning this summer with a new limited-edition design and a mission to support student success.
